posts.text:
My last public conversation with @ScottAdamsSays 

Uploading it here for posterity. Rest in peace. 💜

Video

Not everything needs to be 'content'. It's ok for some personal things to remain private.

We managed this for all human history until around 15 years ago.
I'm pretty sure that if I hadn't been going to the gym regularly for the past 20+ years, I'd be a significantly different (worse) person in all aspects.

Yeah...


ZUBY: (@ZubyMusic)

I have political fatigue and I can't be alone in this regard.



— https://nitter.net/ZubyMusic/status/1895371269320954101#m
First day in Dubai without missiles and drones since this nonsense all kicked off. 😃

"How can you be happy when bad things are happening in the world?"

One of the goofiest mindsets that exists. ☝🏾

One spot remaining for the men's retreat in Las Vegas next month!

If you want to join us, send a DM to @tyromper


Tyler Todt (@tyromper)

Ever wanted to spend a few days with @ZubyMusic ?

Ever wanted to race to sand dunes in the Mojave Desert with a group of guys that feel like brothers?

Ever wanted to talk business, fatherhood, marriage, health & life with like minded men & level up?

Ever wanted to take a few days FOR YOURSELF & reset your nervous system?

May 28,29,30,31st I have ONE OPEN

And adds thousands of hours of joy. 💜


World of Statistics (@stats_feed)

A new baby usually deprives each of it’s parents around 350-400 hours of sleep in the first year.



— https://nitter.net/stats_feed/status/2041795583665451452#m

That 'ceasefire' did not last long...

Air defense systems are currently responding to a missile threat. Please remain in a safe location and follow official channels for warnings and updates.
